subject: Marketplace: Integration & Security sections - RFI responses
messages:
From: Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@cloud-retail.com>

Cc: aws-marketplace-seller-support@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace questionnaire: Integration / Security sections

Marcus,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our listing review we need more detailed answers for the Integration and Security sections of the marketplace questionnaire. Key asks:

- SSO & identity: SAML/OIDC support, recommended IdP mapping, JIT provisioning constraints.
- Key management: BYOK/KMS integrations and whether HSM is supported for Private deployments.
- Network & endpoints: egress IP ranges, VPC peering options for Redwood Private, TLS ciphers and mTLS support.
- Metering & billing: meter types (token vs request), timing for usage export to AWS billing, sample usage CSV.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 scope, PII handling, data retention and log exporting options.

Can you provide written answers and any diagrams by 6/14? If helpful, attach a short PDF. We will include your responses in the vendor review packet.

Regards,
Sarah Morgan
Procurement Manager, CloudRetail Inc

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@cloud-retail.com>, aws-marketplace-seller-support@amazon.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace questionnaire: Integration / Security sections

Marcus / Jasmine — draft answers below for the technical section. Please review and flag edits.

1) SSO & Identity
- Redwood supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. We provide an SSO guide for AWS SSO, Okta, Azure AD. JIT provisioning is supported for OIDC; SAML provisioning requires SCIM for automatic user sync.
- Recommended claims: email, name, groups. We map groups to role bindings in the Console.

2) Key Management
- Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS for ease of use. Dedicated & Private: customer-managed KMS (BYOK) supported via AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS APIs. Private on-prem deployments can integrate with customer HSMs via PKCS#11.
- Stored secrets are encrypted at rest; customer keys never leave their KMS when BYOK is configured.

3) Network & Endpoints
- For Redwood Private we offer VPC peering and private endpoint (AWS PrivateLink) options. Egress IP ranges are documented in our firewall guide; we can provide fixed NAT IPs for Dedicated pools.
- TLS: TLS 1.2+ with modern cipher suites; optional mTLS supported for service-to-service connections on Dedicated/Private.

Notes: I'll export a network diagram and sample SCIM/SAML configs for the packet.

—Karthik

Attachment: tech-section-draft.md (stub)

From: aws-marketplace-seller-support@amazon.com
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Morgan <sarah.morgan@cloud-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketplace questionnaire: Integration / Security sections

Marcus — quick clarifications from the marketplace intake team:

- Metering: AWS prefers usage exports in hourly CSVs with a usage key we can map to your meter dimension. If you prefer token-based metering, include a sample CSV showing tokens consumed per customer per hour.
- Billing cycle: provide the expected billing delay (e.g., hourly metering exported and billed at month end) and whether refunds/credits are supported for mis-billing.
- Listing process: attach your seller onboarding playbook (we just need the sections that impact listing automation).

If you can append the CSV template and a short note on billing timing to your packet, we'll be able to move forward faster.

Thanks,
AWS Marketplace Seller Support

Subject: Re: Marketplace questionnaire: Integration / Security sections - Consolidated packet attached

Sarah / Team,

Attached is our consolidated packet and the sample metering CSV you requested. Highlights:

- Metering: We support both token-based and request-based meters. Attached CSV shows hourly token consumption per account; export hooks are available to push to S3 for AWS ingestion.
- Billing: Usage is exported hourly and billed monthly; adjustments/credits handled via our billing portal and via AWS marketplace reconciliation flow.
- Compliance: SOC 2 scope includes our serving runtime and control plane; SOC 2 summary attached and we can schedule a secure artifact exchange for full reports.
- Network & KMS: network diagram and KB articles attached; BYOK and HSM integration supported for Private deployments.

Attachments:
- RFI_Answers_marketplace_20270614.pdf — consolidated written answers
- network_diagram.png — high-level VPC/PrivateLink diagram
- soc2-summary.pdf — redacted SOC 2 summary
- sample_metering_hourly.csv — example usage CSV (stub)

Next steps: please confirm if the packet format is sufficient for listing. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the tech pieces.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
